source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the preparation of aldehydes (PDF 102-103).

blocks.text: Aldehydes primary alcohols ko tezaabi K2Cr2O7 ya tezaabi KMnO4 se oxidise kar ke banaye jate hain: CH3CH2OH + [O] -> CH3CHO + H2O (K2Cr2O7 + H2SO4(aq), garmi).

Ethanal banane ke liye tezaabi K2Cr2O7 qatra qatra garam ethanol mein dala jata hai, aur ethanal bante hi distil kar ke nikal liya jata hai. Is se is ki mazeed oxidation ethanoic acid mein nahi hoti. Darja hararat ethanal (acetaldehyde) ke ubalne ke darje se oopar lekin ethanol ke darje se neeche rakha jata hai, jo zyada darje par ubalta hai. Khalis ethanal dobara distillation se milta hai.

blocks.alt: Aala: H2SO4(aq) wala gol flask paani ya tel ke bath (bath) mein jis ka darja hararat aldehyde ke ubalne ke darje se zyada hai, neeche se garmi (heat). Side neck mein jhuka hua dropping funnel K2Cr2O7(aq) aur alcohol dheere dheere daalta hai. Thermometer ka bulb side arm ke barabar. Dhalwan condenser (paani neeche se andar, oopar se bahar) test tube mein aldehyde distillate tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 23.1: Ethanol ki oxidation se bante hi ethanal ko distil kar ke nikalne ka aala (kitab ki Figure 23.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Flask mein pehle se halka H2SO4(aq) hai aur garam bath mein rakha hai. Funnel se K2Cr2O7(aq) aur alcohol ka mixture dheere dheere tapkaya jata hai; ethanal bante hi bukharat (vapour) ban kar side arm se condenser mein jata hai, kyunke bath ka darja hararat ethanal ke ubalne ke darje (21 degree C) se zyada lekin ethanol (78 degree C) se kam rakha jata hai. Thermometer ka bulb side arm ke saamne hai taa ke nikalne wali bukharat ka darja naapa ja sake. Condenser mein thanda paani neeche se andar aur oopar se bahar jata hai. Kitab ke matan mein likha hai ke tezaabi K2Cr2O7 garam ethanol mein dala jata hai, jab ke figure mein K2Cr2O7 aur alcohol dono funnel mein hain; dono tareeqe chalte hain, asal baat yeh hai ke ethanal foran distil ho jaye.

blocks.title: Methanal
blocks.text: Methanal, HCHO, kamre ke darja hararat par gas hai. Yeh aksar 40% aabi mehlool ki shakal mein milta hai jise formalin kehte hain, jis ki tez, na-pasandeeda boo hai aur jo hayatiyati namoone mehfooz rakhne mein use hota hai. Doosre chhoti zanjeer wale aldehydes aur ketones maaye hain.

blocks.prompt: Ethanal bante hi distil kar ke kyun nikala jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Warna tezaabi dichromate use mazeed oxidise kar ke ethanoic acid bana deta.

items: Aldehyde bante hi distil karein taa ke tezaab tak oxidation na ho.
